post.description:
Idempotent upsert. Replaces tags wholesale per image (simpler than
diffing tag rows; tag count per image is small, ≤ 30 typical).

Apply tombstone events: when local user deletes something, cloud
drops it too (otherwise UGC keeps matching ghost rows).

Replace the synonym dict file. Hot-reloads the in-process cache via
the version bump that match_synonyms._write does.

Merge incoming settings into cloud's config.json. Only the keys
actually sent are touched — existing keys not in the payload are
preserved (so partial pushes don't wipe what we already have).

get.description: Liveness endpoint for the local sync_worker to confirm cloud is up.
All images that were generated from this seed (parent_id chain).
Cell counts for `row × col` tag dimensions.

post.description: Scope: generate:write — most H5 keys should not be granted this.

Match a piece of text against the image library.

Returns up to `limit` images ranked by:
  - cross-modal embedding similarity (Ark vision, same space as text)
  - tag dimension hits extracted from the text via jieba + tag schema
  - blur quality, business rules, diversity

See match_strategy.STRATEGY_PRESETS for weight defaults; pass
`weights` to override per-call.

UGC client reports that an image was chosen / displayed. Drives
precision telemetry and (later) weight tuning.

Idempotency: client SHOULD pass request_id so duplicates can be merged
in analysis. Server stores every call as a separate row to keep the
write hot path fast.

Find images visually similar to a seed. Reuses the same embedding
matrix and post-processing pipeline as /images/match — only the query
vector source differs (image embedding instead of text embedding).

get.description: Static list of strategy presets the client can pick from.
List images with filters. Returns JSON with CDN-ready URLs.
Serve image file. Optional size param for thumbnail (128/300/800).
List tag distribution for a project.

ConfigSyncBody.title: ConfigSyncBody
ConfigSyncBody.description:
Selective config push. Local should send ONLY the keys the cloud
needs (embedding provider + relays). Never push OSS access keys or
generation provider keys — cloud doesn't upload or generate.

MatchScopeBody.title: MatchScopeBody
MatchScopeBody.description:
How candidates should be distributed across projects.

`primary_project_id` is the call's home project (typically derived from
the API key's binding; the playground passes the operator's currently
selected project). The auto-quota algorithm gives this project at least
75% of slots and only lets other projects in when the text is genuinely
relevant to them.

`force_single_project` is a debug-only override that disables all
cross-project leakage. The playground exposes this as 「强制单项目」.

SynonymsSyncBody.description: Whole-dictionary replace (small payload, simpler than diff sync).
